scope: Static receive projection only. The cases do not establish a handshake or native TCP behavior.
assumptions: The seed tuple and cursors are supplied model values.
The caller assumes that the endpoint transmitted the bytes in the sent-byte buffer.
The profile uses the permitted fixed MAX.SND.WND value 65535, without window scaling.
ACK requests do not establish packet transmission.
Peer-window updates, timers, rate limits, and send events are outside this projection.
